newsitem.title: UK: Welcome Break sets 321 mln stg four-tranche bond.
newsitem.headline: Welcome Break sets 321 mln stg four-tranche bond.

text.p: Welcome Break Finance Plc has launched a 321 million stg four-tranche secured bond issue, joint arrangers Bankers Trust international and Chase Manhattan said on Tuesday.
Welcome Break, a chain of motorway service stations in Britain, was bought by Bahrain-based INVESTCORP earlier this year for 476 million stg.
There is a 42 million stg A-1 tranche with a June 2007 maturity and paying three-month LIBOR plus 65 basis points.
There is an 85 million stg A-2 tranche with a March 2011 maturity and paying three-month LIBOR plus 85 b.p. for 10 years, rising to three-month LIBOR plus 200 b.p. thereafter.
There is a 127 million stg A-3 fixed-rate tranche with a September 2015 maturity which will be priced 95 b.p. over gilts.
There is a 67 million stg B-1 fixed-rate tranche with a September 2017 maturity which will be priced 130 b.p. over gilts.
All tranches will amortise, at different rates. The A-1, A-2 and A-3 legs are rated A by S&P while the B-1 leg is rated BBB.
All four tranches will be reoffered at their par issue price. The fixed-rate coupons will be paid quarterly, as will the FRNs. Coupon dates are the first of March, June, September and December.
The FRNs are callable on any coupon date. The fixed-rate paper carries a Spens clause at gilts flat.
Denominations are 1,000 stg, 10,000 stg and 100,000 stg. The payment date is August 12.
